The users test now passes (`npm test`: 1 pass, 0 fail).

The migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` wrote and read `full_name`. That caused the "unknown column users.full_name" error. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`. I didn't touch `migrations/`.
